title: P112: close all rational exterior choices for a fixed P8 extension
body:
## Result

For the fixed P112 target pairs `{0,67}`, `{7,64}`, `{1,75}`, the prescribed six-query P8 extension costs at least 18 for **every rational exterior vector h with rank[c0,c1,c2,h]=4**, including vectors on all 112 ports and arbitrary copy-asymmetric rational readers. Equality is attained, so this family cannot improve the three canonical terms' cost 18.

The proof reduces all rational exterior choices to 324 exact source zero patterns. Minimal-reader recovery then gives 32,400 support cells per pattern. The original exterior costs 21; a proved support reduction reaches 18, with the two dense P8-specific queries unused. This is a complete family exclusion at one fixed dictionary and marking, not a bounded coefficient sweep.

## Verification

- A standalone primary checker derives the zero-pattern quotient and solves 160 distinct full-group tariff tables; a separate checker exhausts all 10,497,600 source/reader cells without pruning. Their 324-row minimum digests agree.
- Both checkers rebuild all 4,096 physical tariffs, retain the rank-collapse and missing-half-root controls, and verify exact attaining endpoints. The independent checker also audits the classical P8 representation.
- Registered replay, metadata, source history and committed-byte preflight pass at `f322c60e0542d99e2a1ab1880eec2e423e5ea72f`.
- Both commands pass from the official Git-free export with empty PATH and read-only files; all 13 exported file hashes stay unchanged (2.11 seconds, Python 3.12.14, Windows).

Reproduce: `python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-p8-exterior-family`.

## Scope and provenance

This does not cover other query dictionaries or physical placements, changed allowed-free fitting entries, or the additional readers available when h already lies in the three-target span. It supplies no global 334 floor, cheaper full decoder, native schedule or multiplication-bound improvement.

The P8 representation is credited to Choe, Oxley, Sokal and Wagner, *Homogeneous Multivariate Polynomials with the Half-Plane Property*, Example 11.8 and Appendix A.4. The extra point `c0+h` is stated explicitly. Earlier five-query P8 coverage and the P112 cover/pricing lineage retain their attribution.

Canonical main was refreshed and remains `12fa8c5c844be21bfefb38a19503fbd867a11244` (priority revision 7). The donor's assigned decoder goal is recorded as a scope change. The earlier complete 354-open-PR snapshot was supplemented by a current update-ordered delta scan; Discussion coverage remains unavailable after persistent HTTP 406. No exhaustive novelty claim is made.

Prepared by flyingviper with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance and separate AI-agent mathematical and implementation checks. No independent human or proof-assistant review is claimed. Apache-2.0.
